parts.text: Morgan's father allocated $90 for her birthday celebration.
She plans for each attendee, including herself, to participate in a round of mini-golf, have arcade tokens worth $5, and enjoy two go-kart rides.
The mini-golf costs $5 per round and each go-kart ride is priced at $10.
What is the maximum number of friends Morgan can invite to her party?

parts.text: Morgan's dad gave her a budget of $90 for her birthday party.
She wants to ensure that she and her friends each get to play one round of mini-golf, have $5 in arcade tokens, and get to ride the go-karts twice.
A round of mini-golf is $5.
The Go-karts cost $10 a ride.
Additionally, there's a magic show happening at the same time that costs $15 to watch, but Morgan and her friends are not interested in it.
Given these conditions, how many friends can Morgan invite to her party?

parts.text: A train travels between 3 different cities.
It goes 60 miles from the first city to the second city, 120 miles from the second city to the third city, and 40 miles less than that combined distance to go from the third city to the first city.
It does this trip 3 times a day.
The train needs service every 19,200 miles so how many days does it go between services?
